from_quote: a power ſimilar to that which has been granted for the regulation of commerce
rationale: The paragraph refers to "the power ... granted for the regulation of commerce" as a comparison, which names the commerce clause of Article I, Section 8.
to_quote: To regulate Commerce with foreign Nations, and among the several States

from_quote: the particular diſtrict of ten miles, which is to be the ſeat of government
rationale: The paragraph names "the particular district of ten miles, which is to be the seat of government," in which "the legislative power will be vested in the president, senate, and house of representatives"; only the district clause (Article I, Section 8, Clause 17) provides for such a district.
to_quote: exclusive Legislation in all Cases whatsoever

from_quote: in all criminal caſes, the trial by jury ſhall be preſerved
rationale: The paragraph says the Constitution declares that "in all criminal cases, the trial by jury shall be preserved"; it describes the jury-trial clause of Article III, Section 2, Clause 3 without quoting it.
to_quote: The Trial of all Crimes, except in Cases of Impeachment, shall be by Jury

from_quote: the proceedings of the ſupreme court are to be regulated by the congreſs
rationale: The paragraph says "the proceedings of the supreme court are to be regulated by the congress," which describes the regulation of the Supreme Court's appellate jurisdiction by Congress in Article III, Section 2, Clause 2.
to_quote: with such Exceptions, and under such Regulations as the Congress shall make

from_quote: The preſident is to be choſen by electors, nominated in ſuch manner as the legiſlature of each ſtate may direct
rationale: The paragraph says the President "is to be chosen by electors, nominated in such manner as the legislature of each state may direct," which restates the wording of Article II, Section 1, Clause 2 in different order.
to_quote: in such Manner as the Legislature thereof may direct, a Number of Electors

from_quote: choſen every ſecond year by the people of the ſeveral ſtates, and the electors in each ſtate ſhall have the qualifications requiſite
rationale: The paragraph reproduces the wording of Article I, Section 2, Clause 1 on the choosing of the House of Representatives and the qualifications of its electors, without quotation marks and with only the case of the initial letters differing.
to_quote: chosen every second Year by the People of the several States, and the Electors in each State shall have the Qualifications requisite

from_quote: without prejudice to the powers of the legiſlature in the election of ſenators
rationale: The paragraph refers to "the powers of the legislature in the election of senators," which is the election of Senators by the state legislatures in Article I, Section 3, Clause 1.

from_quote: the concurrence of two thirds of the congreſs may at any time introduce alterations and amendments
rationale: The paragraph says that "the concurrence of two thirds of the congress may at any time introduce alterations and amendments," which describes the first power in Article V; the article is not named.
to_quote: whenever two thirds of both Houses shall deem it necessary, shall propose Amendments to this Constitution
